using MPI
using CUDA
using JSON3
using Random
CUDA.allowscalar(false)

function cuda_kernel_ddp_twoparam_b_1!(b, h, i_m, i_n, u, w)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(i_m - 1, 1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_j = 1 + (__tid - 1)
    s = b[i_j]
    for i_k = 1:i_n
        s = s + w[(i_j - 1) * i_n + i_k] * u[i_k]
    end
    h[i_j] = s
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_ddp_twoparam_b_2!(h, i_m, o, u)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(i_m - 1, 1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_j2 = 1 + (__tid - 1)
    o[i_j2] = h[i_j2] - u[1]
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_ddp_twoparam_b_3!(i_m, loss, o)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(i_m - 1, 1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_j3 = 1 + (__tid - 1)
    CUDA.@atomic loss[1] += o[i_j3] ^ 2
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_ddp_twoparam_b_4!(i_m, lossb, o, ob)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(1 - i_m, -1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_j3 = i_m + (__tid - 1) * -1
    ob[i_j3] = ob[i_j3] + (2 * o[i_j3]) * lossb[1]
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_ddp_twoparam_b_5!(hb, i_m, ob, ub)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(1 - i_m, -1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_j2 = i_m + (__tid - 1) * -1
    __oldb_0 = ob[i_j2]
    ob[i_j2] = 0.0
    hb[i_j2] = hb[i_j2] + __oldb_0
    CUDA.@atomic ub[1] += -__oldb_0
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_ddp_twoparam_b_6!(bb, hb, i_m, i_n, u, ub, w, wb)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(1 - i_m, -1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_j = i_m + (__tid - 1) * -1
    sb = 0.0
    __oldb_0 = hb[i_j]
    hb[i_j] = 0.0
    sb = sb + __oldb_0
    for i_k = i_n:-1:1
        wb[(i_j - 1) * i_n + i_k] = wb[(i_j - 1) * i_n + i_k] + u[i_k] * sb
        CUDA.@atomic ub[i_k] += w[(i_j - 1) * i_n + i_k] * sb
    end
    __oldb_0 = sb
    sb = 0.0
    bb[i_j] = bb[i_j] + __oldb_0
    return nothing
end

function ddp_twoparam_b_cuda(loss, lossb, u, ub, w, wb, b, bb, h, hb, o, ob, i_n, i_m)
    nthread_per_block = 256
    s = 0.0
    sb = 0.0
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = max(1, Base.cld(div(i_m - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block)) cuda_kernel_ddp_twoparam_b_1!(b, h, i_m, i_n, u, w)
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = max(1, Base.cld(div(i_m - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block)) cuda_kernel_ddp_twoparam_b_2!(h, i_m, o, u)
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = max(1, Base.cld(div(i_m - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block)) cuda_kernel_ddp_twoparam_b_3!(i_m, loss, o)
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = max(1, Base.cld(div(1 - i_m, -1) + 1, nthread_per_block)) cuda_kernel_ddp_twoparam_b_4!(i_m, lossb, o, ob)
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = max(1, Base.cld(div(1 - i_m, -1) + 1, nthread_per_block)) cuda_kernel_ddp_twoparam_b_5!(hb, i_m, ob, ub)
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = max(1, Base.cld(div(1 - i_m, -1) + 1, nthread_per_block)) cuda_kernel_ddp_twoparam_b_6!(bb, hb, i_m, i_n, u, ub, w, wb)
    return nothing
end

function initstacks_ddp_twoparam_b_cuda()
    return nothing
end

function ddp_twoparam_b_reset_accum!(wb, bb)
    fill!(wb, 0.0)
    fill!(bb, 0.0)
    return nothing
end

function ddp_twoparam_b_reset_reduced!(loss)
    fill!(loss, 0.0)
    return nothing
end

function ddp_twoparam_b_reset_local!(ub, hb, ob)
    fill!(ub, 0.0)
    fill!(hb, 0.0)
    fill!(ob, 0.0)
    return nothing
end

function ddp_twoparam_b_allreduce!(wb, bb, loss, n_local, comm)
    MPI.Allreduce!(wb, +, comm)
    MPI.Allreduce!(bb, +, comm)
    MPI.Allreduce!(loss, +, comm)
    return MPI.Allreduce(n_local, +, comm)
end

function ddp_twoparam_b_check_replicas(w, b, lossb, comm)
    bad = String[]
    for (nm, arr) = (("w", w), ("b", b), ("lossb", lossb))
        c1 = sum(arr)
        c2 = sum(abs, arr)
        agree = MPI.Allreduce(c1, min, comm) == MPI.Allreduce(c1, max, comm) && MPI.Allreduce(c2, min, comm) == MPI.Allreduce(c2, max, comm)
        agree || push!(bad, nm)
    end
    isempty(bad) || error("ddp_twoparam_b_check_replicas: `" * join(bad, "`, `") * "` differ across ranks. A :shared or :seed buffer must hold identical values on every rank. The usual cause is a per-sample array left out of per_sample")
    return nothing
end


function cuda_kernel_ddp_twoparam_hv_1!(b, bd, h, hd, i_m, i_n, u, ud, w, wd)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(i_m - 1, 1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_j = 1 + (__tid - 1)
    sd = bd[i_j]
    s = b[i_j]
    for i_k = 1:i_n
        __hcse_0 = u[i_k]
        __hcse_1 = w[(i_j - 1) * i_n + i_k]
        sd = sd + (__hcse_0 * wd[(i_j - 1) * i_n + i_k] + __hcse_1 * ud[i_k])
        s = s + __hcse_1 * __hcse_0
    end
    hd[i_j] = sd
    h[i_j] = s
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_ddp_twoparam_hv_2!(h, hd, i_m, o, od, u, ud)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(i_m - 1, 1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_j2 = 1 + (__tid - 1)
    od[i_j2] = hd[i_j2] + -(ud[1])
    o[i_j2] = h[i_j2] - u[1]
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_ddp_twoparam_hv_3!(i_m, loss, lossd, o, od)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(i_m - 1, 1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_j3 = 1 + (__tid - 1)
    __hcse_2 = o[i_j3]
    CUDA.@atomic lossd[1] += (2__hcse_2) * od[i_j3]
    CUDA.@atomic loss[1] += __hcse_2 ^ 2
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_ddp_twoparam_hv_4!(i_m, lossb, lossbd, o, ob, obd, od)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(1 - i_m, -1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_j3 = i_m + (__tid - 1) * -1
    __hcse_3 = lossb[1]
    __hcse_4 = 2 * o[i_j3]
    obd[i_j3] = obd[i_j3] + (__hcse_3 * (2 * od[i_j3]) + __hcse_4 * lossbd[1])
    ob[i_j3] = ob[i_j3] + __hcse_4 * __hcse_3
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_ddp_twoparam_hv_5!(hb, hbd, i_m, ob, obd, ub, ubd)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(1 - i_m, -1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_j2 = i_m + (__tid - 1) * -1
    __oldb_0d = obd[i_j2]
    __oldb_0 = ob[i_j2]
    obd[i_j2] = 0.0
    ob[i_j2] = 0.0
    hbd[i_j2] = hbd[i_j2] + __oldb_0d
    hb[i_j2] = hb[i_j2] + __oldb_0
    CUDA.@atomic ubd[1] += -__oldb_0d
    CUDA.@atomic ub[1] += -__oldb_0
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_ddp_twoparam_hv_6!(bb, bbd, hb, hbd, i_m, i_n, u, ub, ubd, ud, w, wb, wbd, wd)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(1 - i_m, -1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_j = i_m + (__tid - 1) * -1
    sbd = 0.0
    sb = 0.0
    __oldb_0d = hbd[i_j]
    __oldb_0 = hb[i_j]
    hbd[i_j] = 0.0
    hb[i_j] = 0.0
    sbd = sbd + __oldb_0d
    sb = sb + __oldb_0
    for i_k = i_n:-1:1
        __hcse_5 = u[i_k]
        wbd[(i_j - 1) * i_n + i_k] = wbd[(i_j - 1) * i_n + i_k] + (sb * ud[i_k] + __hcse_5 * sbd)
        wb[(i_j - 1) * i_n + i_k] = wb[(i_j - 1) * i_n + i_k] + __hcse_5 * sb
        __hcse_6 = w[(i_j - 1) * i_n + i_k]
        CUDA.@atomic ubd[i_k] += sb * wd[(i_j - 1) * i_n + i_k] + __hcse_6 * sbd
        CUDA.@atomic ub[i_k] += __hcse_6 * sb
    end
    __oldb_0d = sbd
    __oldb_0 = sb
    sbd = 0.0
    sb = 0.0
    bbd[i_j] = bbd[i_j] + __oldb_0d
    bb[i_j] = bb[i_j] + __oldb_0
    return nothing
end

function ddp_twoparam_hv_cuda(loss, lossb, u, ub, w, wb, b, bb, h, hb, o, ob, i_n, i_m, lossd, lossbd, ud, ubd, wd, wbd, bd, bbd, hd, hbd, od, obd)
    nthread_per_block = 256
    s = 0.0
    sb = 0.0
    sd = 0.0
    sbd = 0.0
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = max(1, Base.cld(div(i_m - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block)) cuda_kernel_ddp_twoparam_hv_1!(b, bd, h, hd, i_m, i_n, u, ud, w, wd)
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = max(1, Base.cld(div(i_m - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block)) cuda_kernel_ddp_twoparam_hv_2!(h, hd, i_m, o, od, u, ud)
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = max(1, Base.cld(div(i_m - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block)) cuda_kernel_ddp_twoparam_hv_3!(i_m, loss, lossd, o, od)
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = max(1, Base.cld(div(1 - i_m, -1) + 1, nthread_per_block)) cuda_kernel_ddp_twoparam_hv_4!(i_m, lossb, lossbd, o, ob, obd, od)
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = max(1, Base.cld(div(1 - i_m, -1) + 1, nthread_per_block)) cuda_kernel_ddp_twoparam_hv_5!(hb, hbd, i_m, ob, obd, ub, ubd)
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = max(1, Base.cld(div(1 - i_m, -1) + 1, nthread_per_block)) cuda_kernel_ddp_twoparam_hv_6!(bb, bbd, hb, hbd, i_m, i_n, u, ub, ubd, ud, w, wb, wbd, wd)
    return nothing
end

function initstacks_ddp_twoparam_b_cuda()
    return nothing
end

function ddp_twoparam_hv_reset_accum!(wb, bb, wbd, bbd)
    fill!(wb, 0.0)
    fill!(bb, 0.0)
    fill!(wbd, 0.0)
    fill!(bbd, 0.0)
    return nothing
end

function ddp_twoparam_hv_reset_reduced!(loss, lossd)
    fill!(loss, 0.0)
    fill!(lossd, 0.0)
    return nothing
end

function ddp_twoparam_hv_reset_local!(ub, hb, ob, ubd, hbd, obd)
    fill!(ub, 0.0)
    fill!(hb, 0.0)
    fill!(ob, 0.0)
    fill!(ubd, 0.0)
    fill!(hbd, 0.0)
    fill!(obd, 0.0)
    return nothing
end

function ddp_twoparam_hv_allreduce!(wb, bb, wbd, bbd, loss, lossd, n_local, comm)
    MPI.Allreduce!(wb, +, comm)
    MPI.Allreduce!(bb, +, comm)
    MPI.Allreduce!(wbd, +, comm)
    MPI.Allreduce!(bbd, +, comm)
    MPI.Allreduce!(loss, +, comm)
    MPI.Allreduce!(lossd, +, comm)
    return MPI.Allreduce(n_local, +, comm)
end

function ddp_twoparam_hv_check_replicas(w, b, wd, bd, lossb, lossbd, comm)
    bad = String[]
    for (nm, arr) = (("w", w), ("b", b), ("wd", wd), ("bd", bd), ("lossb", lossb), ("lossbd", lossbd))
        c1 = sum(arr)
        c2 = sum(abs, arr)
        agree = MPI.Allreduce(c1, min, comm) == MPI.Allreduce(c1, max, comm) && MPI.Allreduce(c2, min, comm) == MPI.Allreduce(c2, max, comm)
        agree || push!(bad, nm)
    end
    isempty(bad) || error("ddp_twoparam_hv_check_replicas: `" * join(bad, "`, `") * "` differ across ranks. A :shared or :seed buffer must hold identical values on every rank. The usual cause is a per-sample array left out of per_sample")
    return nothing
end




MPI.Init()
comm   = MPI.COMM_WORLD
rank   = MPI.Comm_rank(comm)
nranks = MPI.Comm_size(comm)
lcomm  = MPI.Comm_split_type(comm, MPI.COMM_TYPE_SHARED, 0)
lrank  = MPI.Comm_rank(lcomm)
CUDA.device!(lrank % CUDA.ndevices())

node = Dict{String,Any}("hostname" => gethostname(), "rank" => rank,
                        "local_rank" => lrank, "device" => string(CUDA.device()))
try node["driver"] = string(CUDA.driver_version()) catch e; node["driver"] = "?" end
try node["runtime"] = string(CUDA.runtime_version()) catch e; node["runtime"] = "?" end
println(stderr, "NODE: ", node); flush(stderr)

const NS = 8          # samples in the batch
const IN = 6
const IM = 5

# Shared parameters are identical on every rank by construction: one seed,
# drawn before any rank-dependent choice.
Random.seed!(20260905)
w_h = randn(IM * IN); b_h = randn(IM)
samples = [randn(IN) for _ in 1:NS]

mkdev(x) = CuArray(Float32.(x))

# ---- adjoint --------------------------------------------------------
function run_adjoint(mine)
    loss = CUDA.zeros(Float32, 1); lossb = CUDA.ones(Float32, 1)
    u  = CUDA.zeros(Float32, IN);  ub = CUDA.zeros(Float32, IN)
    w  = mkdev(w_h);  wb = CUDA.zeros(Float32, IM * IN)
    bb_ = CUDA.zeros(Float32, IM); bpar = mkdev(b_h)
    h  = CUDA.zeros(Float32, IM);  hb = CUDA.zeros(Float32, IM)
    o  = CUDA.zeros(Float32, IM);  ob = CUDA.zeros(Float32, IM)
    ddp_twoparam_b_reset_accum!(wb, bb_)
    ddp_twoparam_b_reset_reduced!(loss)
    for s in mine
        ddp_twoparam_b_reset_local!(ub, hb, ob)
        copyto!(u, Float32.(samples[s]))
        fill!(lossb, 1.0f0)
        ddp_twoparam_b_cuda(loss, lossb, u, ub, w, wb, bpar, bb_, h, hb, o, ob, IN, IM)
    end
    return (loss = loss, wb = wb, bb = bb_)
end

result = Dict{String,Any}()

# reference: every rank runs the whole batch alone, no collective
ref = run_adjoint(1:NS)
# DDP: each rank takes its share, then one collective
mine = [s for s in 1:NS if mod(s - 1, nranks) == rank]
ddp = run_adjoint(mine)
n_global = ddp_twoparam_b_allreduce!(ddp.wb, ddp.bb, ddp.loss, length(mine), comm)

if rank == 0
    a = Dict{String,Any}("n_global" => n_global, "n_samples" => NS)
    worst = 0.0
    for (nm, r, g) in (("loss", ref.loss, ddp.loss), ("wb", ref.wb, ddp.wb), ("bb", ref.bb, ddp.bb))
        rh = Array(r); gh = Array(g)
        den = max(maximum(abs, rh), 1.0f0)
        e = maximum(abs, gh .- rh) / den
        a[nm * "_rel_err"] = Float64(e)
        a[nm * "_changed"] = count(!=(0.0f0), rh)
        worst = max(worst, Float64(e))
    end
    a["max_rel_err"] = worst
    result["adjoint"] = a
end

# ---- hvp ------------------------------------------------------------
function run_hvp(mine)
    loss = CUDA.zeros(Float32, 1); lossb = CUDA.ones(Float32, 1)
    u  = CUDA.zeros(Float32, IN);  ub = CUDA.zeros(Float32, IN)
    w  = mkdev(w_h);  wb = CUDA.zeros(Float32, IM * IN)
    bpar = mkdev(b_h); bb_ = CUDA.zeros(Float32, IM)
    h  = CUDA.zeros(Float32, IM);  hb = CUDA.zeros(Float32, IM)
    o  = CUDA.zeros(Float32, IM);  ob = CUDA.zeros(Float32, IM)
    lossd = CUDA.zeros(Float32, 1); lossbd = CUDA.zeros(Float32, 1)
    ud = CUDA.zeros(Float32, IN);  ubd = CUDA.zeros(Float32, IN)
    wd = mkdev(0.1 .* w_h); wbd = CUDA.zeros(Float32, IM * IN)
    bd = mkdev(0.1 .* b_h); bbd = CUDA.zeros(Float32, IM)
    hd = CUDA.zeros(Float32, IM); hbd = CUDA.zeros(Float32, IM)
    od = CUDA.zeros(Float32, IM); obd = CUDA.zeros(Float32, IM)
    ddp_twoparam_hv_reset_accum!(wb, bb_, wbd, bbd)
    ddp_twoparam_hv_reset_reduced!(loss, lossd)
    for s in mine
        ddp_twoparam_hv_reset_local!(ub, hb, ob, ubd, hbd, obd)
        copyto!(u, Float32.(samples[s]))
        fill!(lossb, 1.0f0); fill!(lossbd, 0.0f0)
        ddp_twoparam_hv_cuda(loss, lossb, u, ub, w, wb, bpar, bb_, h, hb, o, ob, IN, IM,
                             lossd, lossbd, ud, ubd, wd, wbd, bd, bbd, hd, hbd, od, obd)
    end
    return (loss = loss, lossd = lossd, wb = wb, bb = bb_, wbd = wbd, bbd = bbd)
end

ref2 = run_hvp(1:NS)
ddp2 = run_hvp(mine)
n2 = ddp_twoparam_hv_allreduce!(ddp2.wb, ddp2.bb, ddp2.wbd, ddp2.bbd, ddp2.loss, ddp2.lossd,
                                length(mine), comm)

if rank == 0
    a = Dict{String,Any}("n_global" => n2)
    worst = 0.0
    for (nm, r, g) in (("loss", ref2.loss, ddp2.loss), ("lossd", ref2.lossd, ddp2.lossd),
                       ("wb", ref2.wb, ddp2.wb), ("bb", ref2.bb, ddp2.bb),
                       ("wbd", ref2.wbd, ddp2.wbd), ("bbd", ref2.bbd, ddp2.bbd))
        rh = Array(r); gh = Array(g)
        den = max(maximum(abs, rh), 1.0f0)
        e = maximum(abs, gh .- rh) / den
        a[nm * "_rel_err"] = Float64(e)
        a[nm * "_changed"] = count(!=(0.0f0), rh)
        worst = max(worst, Float64(e))
    end
    a["max_rel_err"] = worst
    result["hvp"] = a
end

# every rank's identity, gathered so a discrepancy can be attributed
if rank == 0
    nodes = Any[node]
    for src in 1:(nranks - 1)
        push!(nodes, MPI.recv(comm; source = src, tag = 7))
    end
    result["nodes"] = nodes
    result["nranks"] = nranks
    println(JSON3.write(result))
else
    MPI.send(node, comm; dest = 0, tag = 7)
end
